r02.

Premise correction: this repository does not register per-user API rate-limiting middleware, so no per-user request limits are defined. The global Echo middleware registration contains only recovery and CORS in `server/server.go`; API gateway registration adds authentication and a 256 MiB request-body cap in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, not rate limiting.
